member.name: T:Keygate.Protection.Security.SecurityEventSigner
member.summary:
Builds and signs the canonical security-event payload shared with the Go server (pkg/securityevent). The signed string is:
keygate-security-event-v1
 <event_id>
 <license_id>
 <device_id>
 <event_type>
 <occurred_at_unix_seconds>
The license key, token and details are deliberately excluded: the first two are secrets that must not be fed to a signing routine, and details are telemetry that cannot justify a policy action alone.

member.name: T:Keygate.Protection.Storage.IKeygateSecretStore

member.name: T:Keygate.Protection.Storage.FileSecretStore
member.summary:
Default file-backed store.
On Windows the blob is encrypted with DPAPI for the current user, so another account on the same machine cannot read it. On macOS and Linux there is no equivalent dependency-free per-user secret service, so the file is written with mode 0600 and permissions 0700 on its directory. That protects against other users and casual inspection, not against an attacker who already runs code as this user. Supply your own for stronger isolation.
